RE 115310Z. Switching only the bare-king defender to exact WDL/longest-losing-DTZ moves rescued 11 actual board draws at 10+0.1, but lost three draws ordinary Forge had saved. The prespecified no-regressions condition FAILED. The net was +8 draws per 8,192 source IDs, +0.09766 percentage points [0.01221,0.19531]. This is an instructive case where a positive lower bound and no flags still do not meet the registered decision rule. Leave defense-only intervention outside A25.

The attacker was unchanged stock throughout. Against native defense it mated 18/31 at 10+0.1, against exact delaying defense 10/31. All differences were bishop and knight: native strong mates 12/25 vs4/25, while both defenders lost all six bishop-pair games. The three lost native draws occurred in games 3992,5762,7364. At 1+0.1 exact defense saved five additional draws and lost none, +0.06104pp [0.01221,0.12207]. Strong-side mates with stock/exact defenders were 13/8 overall, 7/2 KBN and 6/6 KBB. Zero flags across all 124 true-clock continuations. The exact policy maximizes the table result/delays conversion under its rule; an imperfect attacker's practical reaction can differ.

All 9,785 turns had independently verified move legality, exact defender selection where applicable, terminal rules, bank amounts and clock debit. A second computation from games.csv recovered every switched ID; exact finite empirical resampling tails from the distribution of +1/0/−1 source IDs gave the same intervals to the game (1 to 16 at ten seconds; 1 to 10 at one). Reproduce using frozen 115310Z, canonical native root IDs in 112610Z, complete source histories and twice-audited actual schedule in 120718Z. Same root and both policies on one core, one timed game per core. Times are nanoseconds and the zero-time plant confirms timeout before increment or move. No new plan proposal; the strong-side A25 evidence is separate.
